note: The input reads, scans the language packs and lowers once per lint run; every rule trait and the umbrella receive the result as LINT_INPUT. The language-decision cases moved here from lint-page-path. The operator table also answers LINT_HOST_FACTS (the closedCall, oauth, grant, defaultPorts, httpWire, family and emitKeys the operators state) and the core services registry answers LINT_SERVICES; both are sent before LINT_INPUT.

cases.note: program/read is not hosted in a step, so the run then ends unread; only the decision is asserted
